name: Missaukee County, MI
findings: Missaukee County has 39 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (65% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Missaukee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Missaukee County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
